title: Insert into a Binary Search Tree
summary: Given the root of a binary search tree and a value to insert, add the value while maintaining the BST properties.
statement: Given the root of a binary search tree and a value to insert, add the value while maintaining the BST properties. Return the new root. Multiple valid insertion methods are acceptable as long as the BST remains valid.
constraints: root is a valid BST with unique integer values and val is absent.
Insert val at the unique search position without changing existing values.
Return the root, or the new node for an empty tree.
